name: Matthew Isaac Knoot

attribution.legal_posture: Convicted and sentenced in M.D. Tenn. No. 3:24-cr-00151 to 18 months in prison, one year of supervised release, $15,100 restitution, and $15,100 forfeiture. Sixth Circuit appeal No. 26-5455 and the separate release-pending-appeal matter No. 26-5589 remained pending as of August 14, 2026: No. 26-5455 was being briefed and No. 26-5589 was awaiting submission to a panel. The record states no merits outcome.
